daemon.note: The live pipeline runs as one AI-free program (nodal/live_daemon.py). A stall shows here and in nodal/daemon_state.json — no agent run needed.

models.name: PLAIN
models.sell_text: Sell when the bid hits 95¢ — or it rides to the end of the window.

models.name: EARLY
models.sell_text: Take the money at the 88¢ value line — or it flips once if the wave turns.
models.flip_state: NO FLIP COMING — EARLY has not called this window

models.name: RIPTIDE
models.sell_text: It gets out by itself: +5¢ profit, the model dropping under 50%, or the window ending.

tells.text: The order book behind RIPTIDE's side is stacked hard — ladder imbalance 0.99 out of 1.00. One side is pushing much harder than the other.
All the models that have called are pointing the same way: DOWN.
The price dropped $78 in the last two minutes — a real push, not a drift.
RIPTIDE has its seed and is watching for a dip of 4¢ or more to jump in.

happening: Bitcoin is FALLING — going down and staying down (-78 dollars this window). PLAIN says BUY DOWN; RIPTIDE says BUY DOWN. 2 minutes 06 seconds left in the window.
ruler: How the wave word is picked (the desk's ruler, from this window's own price trail): FLAT = moved less than $40 total and ended within $15 of where it started. ROLLERCOASTER = changed direction 3+ times without getting anywhere. CLIMBING / FALLING = ended $15+ above / below the start without whipping back. Book tells come from the order-book ladder RIPTIDE polls — the desk has no trade-size tape, so this board never claims 'whales'; it says what the book shows.
